findings.text: a stored finding carrying no claim is skipped by the enumerating loop, and when every entry is claimless the brief renders the empty rows as 'Earlier review's findings: it raised none' at line 628 although the earlier review did raise findings that could not be read, so a reviewer is told the predecessor found nothing. Enumerating the raw list by stored index is the right call for keeping dispositions resolved, but an unreadable entry is reported as empty, which is the state this module elsewhere refuses to confuse with none.
